title: NFL Football
description:
Tennessee Titans at Baltimore Ravens
Baltimore (2-1) hosts Tennessee (0-3) in NFL Week 4 at M&T Bank Stadium. Last week, Baltimore beat Dallas, 34-31, as Lamar Jackson threw for two touchdowns and finished 15-of-20 passing for 186 yards. The Titans lost 12-7 to the Giants.

title: NFL Football
description:
Kansas City Chiefs at Las Vegas Raiders
The Las Vegas Raiders host the Kansas City Chiefs at Allegiant Stadium in NFL Week 4. Both teams are unbeaten, sitting atop the AFC West. Las Vegas claimed the last meeting, a 14-12 victory in the last game of the regular season on January 4.
